'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Tom Hollingsworth DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth|Tom Hollingsworth]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Hollingworth|Tom Hollingsworth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
